author: GitHub
description:
Accidentally committed code you didn't mean to? Don't stress, because GitHub has a few easy ways to help you undo it depending on your workflow. If you have already pushed your changes, you can simply click revert to create a quick fix. If you haven't pushed yet, we share the exact terminal command to safely take your commit back while keeping your hard work in place. Check out GitHub for beginners season 3 on our channel for more helpful tips: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r8jQ9hVA2qs&list=PL0lo9MOBetEFcp4SCWinBdpml9B2U25-f
